description: Travel, accommodation and subsistence for the mobility of project staff or the target population. Flights (economy only, evidenced by a boarding pass), hotel and lodging invoices, travel agency invoices, tickets proving a journey was made, individual per diem and travel-expense claim forms, and vehicle fuel for project journeys claimed per kilometre with the vehicle identified. Cues: billet, vol, hôtel, hébergement, per diem, dieta, viajero, destino, passenger, mission, déplacement, gasoil/carburant pour véhicule, frais de mission. Vehicle insurance belongs to EQUIPOS and vehicle maintenance to SERV_TEC, even when they concern the same vehicle. Fuel for generators or premises is CONSUMIBLES. A package that is mainly a purchase of goods, a purchase request, a procurement bid summary, a supplier quotation, a payment voucher, or goods such as wheat flour, equipment, materials or consumables is EQUIPOS or CONSUMIBLES, not travel.
agent_context: Facturas de gastos de viaje. Documentos típicos: billetes de avión/tren, facturas de hotel, recibos de taxi/transporte, justificantes de dietas. Buscar: importe total, fecha, nombre del viajero, destino, motivo del viaje. Las dietas deben indicar número de días y tarifa diaria. A menudo hay múltiples páginas con gastos desglosados. Palabras clave positivas: Boarding Pass, Hotel Receipt, Passenger, viajero, destino, dieta, per diem. No clasificar como VIAJES si el paquete trata principalmente de compra de bienes, solicitud de compra, procurement, bid summary, supplier quotation, payment voucher, wheat flour, equipment, materials or consumables; esos casos pertenecen normalmente a EQUIPOS o CONSUMIBLES.

description: Payroll and employment costs for staff contracted under the labour law of the country of implementation. Pay slips, employment contracts, income-tax withholding returns and social-security contribution documents or their local equivalents, payroll listings, and signed décharge sheets. In humanitarian action projects this line also carries cash-for-work and cash-grant receipts signed by the recipient. The document shows a worker name, a pay period, gross and net amounts and deductions. Cues: salaire, bulletin de paie, état de salaires, nómina, haberes, décharge, CNPS, IRPP, IRPF, cotisation, staffs nationaux, personnel local. Not staff working permanently at headquarters in Extremadura, which is PERS_SEDE, and not unpaid volunteers, which is PERS_VOLUNT.
agent_context: Nóminas y costes laborales de personal contratado localmente. Documentos: nómina mensual, recibo de salario, TC2/RNT de Seguridad Social. Extraer: nombre del trabajador, período (mes/año), salario bruto, retención IRPF, cuota SS empleado, cuota SS empresa, salario neto. Buscar cabeceras: Nómina, Salario, Haberes, Deducciones, Seguridad Social, IRPF.

description: Payroll for staff who carry out their work on a permanent basis at the organisation's headquarters in Extremadura, under Spanish labour law. The document forms are the same as PERS_LOCAL — pay slips, IRPF forms 110/111/190, social-security forms TC1/TC2 — but the employer is the Spanish headquarters entity and the cost is normally charged at a project allocation percentage. Choose this over PERS_LOCAL only when the document shows a Spain-based employer or an explicit imputation percentage.
agent_context: Costes de personal en sede central. Estructura similar a personal local pero bajo normativa del país sede. Puede incluir porcentaje de dedicación al proyecto. Extraer los mismos campos que nómina local. Prestar atención a: porcentaje de imputación, período de dedicación, coste total vs coste imputado al proyecto.

description: Purchase of capital assets: non-consumable items that do not wear out with use, whose useful life exceeds one financial year, and which the organisation keeps and enters in its asset register. Machinery, furniture, non-consumable office equipment, transport equipment, IT equipment and other equipment needed to run the project, together with the compulsory insurance, shipping and transit, customs duties, installation, commissioning or vehicle registration attached to that purchase. Cues: meuble, mobilier, équipement, machine, véhicule, ordinateur, équipement salle scolaire, achat d'équipement, immobilisation. The packet is often a purchase request, purchase order, procurement bid summary, supplier quotation or payment voucher rather than a finished invoice. Items that are consumed or handed out — textbooks, student kits, supplies — are CONSUMIBLES even when they are durable and even when bought for a school. Repair and maintenance of an asset is SERV_TEC, and building work is CONSTRUCCIONES.
agent_context: Facturas de compra de equipos y materiales duraderos. Documentos: factura de proveedor, albarán, orden de compra, purchase request, procurement bid summary, supplier quotation, cheque/payment voucher. Extraer: proveedor, número de factura, fecha, descripción detallada del equipo/material, cantidad, precio unitario, base imponible, IVA, total. Los equipos de alto valor pueden requerir número de serie para el registro de activos. Buscar: Factura, NIF proveedor, modelo, referencia, purchase order, quotation, bid summary, payment voucher.

description: Purchase of consumable materials and supplies needed for planned project activities, including their shipping and customs clearance. These are items used up, replaced or handed out rather than kept and entered in the asset register. Typical cases: office supplies (fourniture de bureau), drinking water for the office, school textbooks (manuels scolaires), student and teaching kits, play and kindergarten materials, foodstuffs, and fuel for the generators at a base (carburant pour les générateurs). Cues: achat de, fourniture, consommable, kit, matériel, denrées, carburant groupe électrogène, wheat flour, hygiene materials, medical consumables. The packet may be a purchase request, supplier quotation, bid summary or payment voucher rather than a finished invoice. Decide by the nature of the item, not by the supplier or the invoice layout. Vehicle fuel for project journeys is VIAJES. Repair, maintenance, photocopying, printing, audiovisual and security services are SERV_TEC.
agent_context: Facturas de material fungible y consumibles: papelería, material de oficina, fungible informático, material sanitario, alimentos o suministros no duraderos. Estructura más sencilla que equipos — sin necesidad de registro de activos. Extraer: proveedor, fecha, descripción de artículos, base imponible, IVA, total. Pueden ser tickets, facturas simplificadas, purchase requests, supplier quotations, bid summaries or payment vouchers. Ejemplos típicos: wheat flour, office supplies, hygiene materials, medical consumables.

description: Infrastructure works, construction or renovation of buildings, and anything that would form part of a works contract: builder and contractor invoices, works certificates (certificación de obra), itemised works budgets, building permits, purchase and transport of construction materials, the cost of personnel carrying out the work, site management and supervision, rubble clearance, mandatory technical reports and compulsory works insurance. Also non-repayable cash grants to the beneficiary population for self-construction or agricultural tasks. Cues: travaux, chantier, construction, réhabilitation, maçonnerie, obra, certificación de obra, permis de construire, matériaux de construction. Choose this over EQUIPOS when the invoice is for building work rather than a movable good. Works on administrative premises or staff accommodation are not eligible.
agent_context: Gastos de obra, construcción y rehabilitación. Documentos: contrato de obra, certificación de obra, factura de constructor o contratista, presupuesto desglosado. Extraer: contratista, fecha, descripción de la obra, importe total, ubicación de la obra.

description: Costs for volunteer staff of the beneficiary organisation or its consortium partners, governed by Spanish volunteering law rather than an employment contract. Volunteer recruitment agreements, accident, sickness and civil-liability insurance policies taken out for volunteers, and rent for volunteer accommodation in the country of implementation. Cues: volontaire, bénévole, voluntario, voluntariado, convention de volontariat, acuerdo de voluntariado, póliza de seguro de voluntarios, assurance volontaire. A salaried pay slip is never this category — that is PERS_LOCAL or PERS_SEDE.
agent_context: Gastos de personal voluntario. Documentos: acuerdo o convenio de voluntariado, póliza de seguro de voluntarios, justificante de asignación o estipendio. Extraer: nombre del voluntario, período, importe, concepto.

description: Technical, professional and consultancy services contracted for the project where there is no employment relationship: delivery of training and seminars, studies, reports and publications, cost control, advisory services, and design and layout of materials. This line also takes repair and maintenance of equipment, photocopying and printing, audiovisual services and security services. It further covers the travel and subsistence of people who provide services to the project but whose fees are not charged to it, such as unpaid speakers. The evidence is a service contract plus a fee invoice stating the tasks assigned, the estimated time or duration and the rate. Cues: honoraires, prestation de services, consultance, formation, étude, entretien, réparation, maintenance, honorarios, consultoría, asistencia técnica. Identification and formulation, building works, and audit or final evaluation each belong to their own budget line and not here. Routine running costs of the local partner's office are FUNCIONAMIENTO.
agent_context: Servicios técnicos y profesionales contratados. Documentos: contrato de prestación de servicios, factura de honorarios. Extraer: prestador del servicio, NIF, fecha, descripción de las tareas, duración, tarifa, importe total.

description: The local partner's routine running costs for keeping its premises operating: electricity, water, communications, maintenance, security, cleaning, and the rent of premises or offices. Typically a recurring monthly utility bill, or a lease agreement with its payment receipts. Cues: facture d'électricité, eau, loyer du bureau, nettoyage, gardiennage, abonnement, communications, électricité, alquiler de oficina, limpieza, vigilancia. Choose this over SERV_TEC when the cost keeps the local partner's office running rather than delivering project expertise, and over CONSUMIBLES when it is a recurring service or utility rather than a purchase of goods. Routine housing costs for staff are not eligible.
agent_context: Gastos corrientes de funcionamiento. Documentos: facturas de suministros (luz, agua, gas, teléfono, internet), contrato y recibos de alquiler de oficina, facturas de limpieza, vigilancia o mantenimiento. Extraer: proveedor o suministrador, período facturado, fecha, importe total.

description: Financial, banking, notarial and registration costs: charges arising from bank transfers of funds between the organisation's own accounts, account maintenance fees, and the costs of international transfers including intermediary-bank fees, evidenced by the documents confirming both the sending and the receipt of the funds. Notary or registration fees belong here only when incurred in order to submit documentation to AEXCID. The evidence is normally a bank certificate or an account statement rather than a commercial invoice. Cues: frais bancaires, commission bancaire, virement, relevé bancaire, comisión bancaria, gastos de transferencia, mantenimiento de cuenta, extracto bancario, certificado bancario. Notary or registration fees arising from registering movable or immovable property belong to that asset's budget line instead. Expenses arising from malpractice or legal breaches are not eligible.
agent_context: Gastos financieros y bancarios. Documentos: extracto bancario, certificado bancario, justificante de comisión o transferencia. Extraer: entidad emisora, fecha, concepto del gasto, importe. Para transferencias internacionales pueden aparecer comisiones de banco intermediario.
